noSpeed.label: No speed bonus
noSpeed.hint: Every correct answer is worth 1000 points, no matter how fast it was given. Ties are settled by sudden death.

fastMode.label: Fast mode
fastMode.hint: Questions follow one another automatically, with no waiting screen or click in between. Ideal for speed quizzes.

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.hint: Brisk but readable: the "Ready?" screen is kept and reading time stays at 2s.

nervous.label: Snappy
nervous.hint: "Ready?" screen removed, 1s to read the question, 2s of results. The sweet spot.

hurryUp.label: Hurry Up!
hurryUp.hint: Maximum pressure: 1s of results and a shrinking answer time (-1s per question, 3s floor).

result.deleteConfirm: Delete result for "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
result.none: No results yet, finish a game to see reports here
result.noneSolo: No solo quiz played yet, share a solo link to collect scores

guest.modalDesc: A guest account signs in at /manager/guest and has its own library: they create their own quizzes without seeing yours. Their quizzes appear in the “Invités” folder.
guest.createInvalid: Name required and password of at least 4 characters
guest.deleteConfirm: Delete account “{{name}}”? Their quiz library will also be deleted.
